issue.title: CSV exports open in a single column in German Excel
issue.body:
Our Vienna office runs Excel with Austrian settings. Double-clicking a CSV
export puts each whole line into column A, as
`Date,Amount,Currency,Description,Category`, because Excel there expects
semicolons between columns. XLSX opens fine, but the tool we load the files
into only takes CSV. Could the CSV export offer a semicolon as the separator,
as a choice next to the format?

input.title: Let CSV exports use a semicolon separator
input.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

toDelimited joins fields with a hard-coded "," and escapeField only quotes on commas. Add an optional delimiter parameter (default ",") used for both the join and the quoting test, so a semicolon can be chosen. Then pass it through CsvOptions in src/export/csv.ts and expose it as an option next to the format in the export API/UI. Default behaviour stays unchanged.

The change would mainly go there: add an optional delimiter, then pass it through CsvOptions in src/export/csv.ts and the export request. I opened a draft PR (pr-19) proposing this.

In short: the CSV separator is hard-coded as "," in toDelimited (and escapeField only quotes on commas), so there is no way to choose a semicolon. formatMinor also writes euro amounts with a comma as the decimal mark, so every Amount cell in these files is quoted today.
